problem_en: A sum of ₹4,50,000 is lent at 8% simple interest per annum. After 3 years, ₹1,50,000 is withdrawn. If the remaining amount continues to earn interest at the same rate for another 2 years, find the total interest earned over the 5-year period.
problem_hi: ₹4,50,000 की राशि 8% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज पर उधार दी जाती है। 3 वर्ष बाद, ₹1,50,000 वापस ले लिए जाते हैं। यदि शेष राशि अगले 2 वर्षों के लिए उसी दर पर ब्याज अर्जित करना जारी रखती है, तो 5 वर्ष की अवधि में अर्जित कुल ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: A sum of ₹4,50,000 is lent at 8% simple interest per annum. 3 years baad, ₹1,50,000 withdraw kar liya gaya. Agar remaining amount same rate par another 2 years ke liye interest earn karti hai, toh 5-year period ka total interest find karo.
problem_hg_065: Ek amount 4 lakh 50 hazaar ₹ 8% Simple Interest p.a. par udhaar diya gaya. 3 years baad usmein se 1 lakh 50 hazaar ₹ withdraw kar liya. Baaki bacha balance agle 2 saal tak same rate par chalta raha. Bataiye total interest kitna bana?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Calculate interest for the first 3 years on the full principal: (450000 * 8 * 3) / 100 = 1,08,000.
Step 2: Calculate the remaining principal after withdrawal: 4,50,000 - 1,50,000 = 3,00,000.
Step 3: Calculate interest for the next 2 years on the reduced principal: (300000 * 8 * 2) / 100 = 48,000.
Step 4: Sum the two interest components: 1,08,000 + 48,000 = 1,56,000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The phrase 'withdraw kar liya' combined with '4 lakh 50 hazaar' creates a dual trap: the Indian numbering system must be parsed, and the model must decide if the interest is calculated on the original sum or if the principal itself is reduced mid-term.
why_hard: LLMs often struggle with state-changes in principal during a simple interest calculation when described colloquially.

problem_en: Person A invests ₹2,00,000 at 10% per annum for 4 years. Person B invests a certain sum at 12% per annum for 5 years. If B's interest is 20% more than A's interest, find the principal invested by B.
problem_hi: व्यक्ति A ₹2,00,000 का 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से 4 वर्ष के लिए निवेश करता है। व्यक्ति B एक निश्चित राशि का 12% प्रति वर्ष की दर से 5 वर्ष के लिए निवेश करता है। यदि B का ब्याज A के ब्याज से 20% अधिक है, तो B द्वारा निवेश किया गया मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Person A invests ₹2,00,000 at 10% per annum for 4 years. Person B invests some amount at 12% p.a. for 5 years. Agar B ka interest A ke interest se 20% zyada hai, toh B ka principal find karo.
problem_hg_065: A ne 2 lakh ₹ invest kiye 10% rate par 4 saal ke liye. B ne kuch amount 12% p.a. par 5 saal ke liye invest kiya. B ko milne wala interest A ke interest se 20% zyada hai. B ka investment kitna tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 2: Calculate B's interest based on '20% zyada' (20% more): 80,000 * 1.20 = 96,000.
Step 3: Set up B's SI equation: (P_B * 12 * 5) / 100 = 96,000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The trap is '20% zyada', which requires the model to correctly identify the base (A's interest) and apply an additive 20% rather than just calculating 20% of the total.
why_hard: Multi-step comparison requires setting up an equation where one interest is a percentage-defined function of the other.

problem_en: A sum of ₹60,000 is invested. Part 1 is lent at 5% and Part 2 is lent at 10%. If the total interest after 2 years is ₹9,000, find the amount lent at 5%.
problem_hi: ₹60,000 की राशि का निवेश किया जाता है। भाग 1 को 5% पर और भाग 2 को 10% पर उधार दिया जाता है। यदि 2 वर्ष बाद कुल ब्याज ₹9,000 है, तो 5% पर उधार दी गई राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: ₹60,000 is invested. Part 1 ko 5% par lend kiya and Part 2 ko 10% par. Agar total interest 2 years baad ₹9,000 hai, toh 5% wala amount find karo.
problem_hg_065: Total ₹60,000 lend kiye gaye. Ismein se kuch 5% par aur baaki 10% Simple Interest par. 2 saal baad dekha toh total interest ₹9,000 bana. 5% par kitna paisa diya gaya tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let amount at 5% be x and at 10% be (60000 - x).
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The word 'baaki' implies the remainder after a split. LLMs sometimes fail to link 'baaki' to the subtraction (Total - Part1) in algebraic setups.
why_hard: Requires splitting a principal into two variables and solving a linear equation based on a combined result.

problem_en: A person earns ₹12,000 interest in 3 years at a rate of R%. If the rate was 2% higher, they would have earned ₹15,000. Find the principal sum.
problem_hi: एक व्यक्ति R% की दर से 3 वर्ष में ₹12,000 ब्याज अर्जित करता है। यदि दर 2% अधिक होती, तो वे ₹15,000 अर्जित करते। मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: A person earns ₹12,000 interest in 3 years at R% rate. Agar rate 2% higher hota, toh ₹15,000 interest milta. Principal find karo.
problem_hg_065: Kisi sum par R% ki dar se 3 saal mein ₹12,000 interest mila. Agar rate pehle se 2% zyada rakha gaya hota, toh ₹15,000 interest banta. Wo principal amount kya hai?
solution_steps_en: Step 2: This difference is caused by the 2% rate increase over 3 years: (P * 2 * 3) / 100 = 3,000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'pehle se 2% zyada' phrase is used to define a hypothetical scenario. The model must isolate the effect of the 2% increase to find the principal without needing the original rate R.
why_hard: Focuses on the delta (change) rather than the absolute values, which is a common point of failure for LLMs.

problem_en: A sum of money amounts to ₹9,440 in 3 years and ₹11,200 in 5 years at simple interest. Find the annual rate of interest.
problem_hi: कोई राशि साधारण ब्याज पर 3 वर्ष में ₹9,440 और 5 वर्ष में ₹11,200 हो जाती है। वार्षिक ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: A sum of money amounts to ₹9,440 in 3 years and ₹11,200 in 5 years. Annual rate of interest calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Ek amount 3 saal mein ₹9,440 ho jata hai aur 5 saal mein ₹11,200 (Simple Interest par). Interest ki annual rate percentage mein bataiye.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Calculate interest for 2 years (5 years - 3 years): 11,200 - 9,440 = 1,760.
Step 3: Calculate principal by subtracting 3 years of interest from the 3-year amount: 9,440 - (3 * 880) = 9,440 - 2,640 = 6,800.
Step 5: (Using updated values for HG_065): 3yr=10160, 5yr=11600. Interest for 2 years=1440. 1yr=720. P = 10160 - 2160 = 8000. Rate = 720/8000 * 100 = 9%.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The word 'ho jata hai' implies 'becomes', indicating the amount (Principal + Interest) rather than just interest. LLMs frequently confuse 'amount' with 'interest'.
why_hard: Distinguishing between interest and final amount is a conceptual hurdle in financial math.

problem_en: An investor lends ₹1,20,000. Part A at 6% p.a. and Part B at 9% p.a. If the interest from Part A for 4 years is equal to the interest from Part B for 3 years, find Part A.
problem_hi: एक निवेशक ₹1,20,000 उधार देता है। भाग A 6% वार्षिक दर पर और भाग B 9% वार्षिक दर पर। यदि 4 वर्षों के लिए भाग A का ब्याज 3 वर्षों के लिए भाग B के ब्याज के बराबर है, तो भाग A ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: An investor lends ₹1,20,000. Part A at 6% p.a. and Part B at 9% p.a. Agar Part A ka interest for 4 years Part B ke interest for 3 years ke equal hai, toh Part A calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: ₹1,20,000 ki total rashi do hisson mein di gayi. Pehle part A par 6% dar se 4 saal ka interest aur dusre part B par 9% dar se 3 saal ka interest barabar hai. Part A kitna hai?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let Part A = x, then Part B = 1,20,000 - x.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The trap is 'do hisson mein di gayi' (split into two parts) and using 'barabar' (equal) for interests after different time periods.
why_hard: The LLM must maintain the relationship between two variables where the product of rate and time differs for each.

problem_en: The simple interest on a certain sum is 16/25 of the principal. If the number of years is equal to the rate percent per annum, find the rate.
problem_hi: एक निश्चित राशि पर साधारण ब्याज मूलधन का 16/25 है। यदि वर्षों की संख्या प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर के बराबर है, तो दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: The simple interest on a certain sum is 16/25 of the principal. Agar number of years and rate percent per annum equal hain, toh rate find karo.
problem_hg_065: Kisi sum ka simple interest uske principal ka 16/25 part hai. Agar rate (dar) aur time (samay) ki numerical value ek dum barabar ho, toh interest ki rate kya hogi?
solution_steps_en: Step 2: Let Rate = R and Time = R.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The phrase 'numerical value ek dum barabar' (numerical values are exactly equal) is a linguistic way to define R = T.
why_hard: Translating a verbal equality of different physical dimensions (Rate and Time) into a single algebraic variable.

problem_en: A bank offers 5% interest for the first 6 months and 7% for the next 6 months. If a person earns ₹4,800 interest in one year, find the principal.
problem_hi: एक बैंक पहले 6 महीनों के लिए 5% ब्याज और अगले 6 महीनों के लिए 7% ब्याज देता है। यदि एक व्यक्ति एक वर्ष में ₹4,800 ब्याज अर्जित करता है, तो मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: A bank offers 5% interest for first 6 months and 7% for next 6 months. Agar koi person ₹4,800 interest earn karta hai in one year, principal find karo.
problem_hg_065: Ek scheme mein pehle 6 mahine 5% rate milta hai aur phir 6 mahine 7% rate apply hota hai. Pure saal ka interest ₹4,800 banta hai. Invest kiya gaya principal kya tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Interest for first half year = (P * 5 * 0.5) / 100 = 2.5P / 100.
Step 2: Interest for second half year = (P * 7 * 0.5) / 100 = 3.5P / 100.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The trap '6 mahine' (6 months) requires unit conversion into years (0.5 years) for standard interest formulas.
why_hard: LLMs often use T=6 instead of T=0.5 when '6' is explicitly mentioned in the text.

problem_en: Sum A is lent at 10% for 2 years and Sum B is lent at 10% for 3 years. If the total interest is ₹5,000 and Sum B is ₹5,000 more than Sum A, find Sum A.
problem_hi: राशि A को 2 वर्ष के लिए 10% पर और राशि B को 3 वर्ष के लिए 10% पर उधार दिया जाता है। यदि कुल ब्याज ₹5,000 है और राशि B, राशि A से ₹5,000 अधिक है, तो राशि A ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Sum A is lent at 10% for 2 years and Sum B is lent at 10% for 3 years. Total interest is ₹5,000 and Sum B, Sum A se ₹5,000 more hai. Sum A find karo.
problem_hg_065: Paisa A 10% par 2 saal ke liye diya aur paisa B bhi 10% par 3 saal ke liye diya. Dono ka total interest ₹5,000 hai. Agar B ki value A se ₹5,000 zyada ho, toh A ki value kya hogi?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let Sum A = x. Then Sum B = x + 5000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The trap is 'B ki value A se ₹5,000 zyada' (B's value is 5,000 more than A), which is a common relational trap.
why_hard: Requires simultaneous management of principal-to-principal relations and interest-to-principal relations.

problem_en: A man lent ₹3,00,000. Some at 4% and some at 6%. If the annual interest is ₹15,000, how much was lent at 6%?
problem_hi: एक व्यक्ति ने ₹3,00,000 उधार दिए। कुछ 4% पर और कुछ 6% पर। यदि वार्षिक ब्याज ₹15,000 है, तो 6% पर कितना उधार दिया गया था?
problem_hg_030: A man lent ₹3,00,000. Some at 4% and some at 6%. Agar annual interest ₹15,000 hai, toh 6% wala amount kitna tha?
problem_hg_065: 3 lakh ₹ total lend kiye gaye. Kuch hissa 4% par aur bacha hua hissa 6% simple interest par. Pure saal ka interest ₹15,000 mila. 6% interest wale hisse ki value bataiye.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let amount at 6% be x. Amount at 4% = 3,00,000 - x.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The trap is '3 lakh' as notation and the implied 'baaki' or 'bacha hua' (remainder) logic for the second part.
why_hard: Simple principal-splitting problem made complex by number notation and mixed syntax.

problem_en: Interest on a sum for 8 months at 6% is ₹250 less than the interest on the same sum for 15 months at 5%. Find the sum.
problem_hi: 6% की दर से 8 महीनों के लिए किसी राशि पर ब्याज, 5% की दर से 15 महीनों के लिए उसी राशि पर ब्याज से ₹250 कम है। राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Interest on a sum for 8 months at 6% is ₹250 less than interest on same sum for 15 months at 5%. Sum find karo.
problem_hg_065: Kisi amount ka 6% rate par 8 mahine ka interest, usi amount ke 5% rate par 15 mahine ke interest se ₹250 kam hai. Wo amount (sum) kitna hai?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: Trap: '8 mahine' and '15 mahine' require conversion to years by dividing by 12.
why_hard: Multiple fractions and temporal conversions in a comparative sentence structure.

problem_en: If a sum of ₹10,000 is lent out in such a way that interest on one part at 8% for 5 years is equal to interest on the other part at 10% for 3 years, find the sum lent at 8%.
problem_hi: यदि ₹10,000 की राशि को इस प्रकार उधार दिया जाता है कि 5 वर्षों के लिए 8% पर एक भाग का ब्याज, 3 वर्षों के लिए 10% पर दूसरे भाग के ब्याज के बराबर है, तो 8% पर उधार दी गई राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: If sum of ₹10,000 is lent such that interest on one part at 8% for 5 years is equal to interest on other part at 10% for 3 years, find sum at 8%.
problem_hg_065: ₹10,000 ko do parts mein aise banta gaya ki pehle part ka 8% dar se 5 saal ka interest, dusre part ke 10% dar se 3 saal ke interest ke 'ek dum barabar' hai. 8% wala part find karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let Part 1 = x. Part 2 = 10000 - x.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'ek dum barabar' (exactly equal) emphasizes the equality constraint in a way that sometimes makes models look for deeper complexity where none exists.
why_hard: Classic equal-interest split with messy coefficients.

problem_en: Total interest earned on ₹5,000 at 4% for X years and ₹4,000 at 5% for X years is ₹2,000. Find the value of X.
problem_hi: ₹5,000 पर 4% की दर से X वर्षों के लिए और ₹4,000 पर 5% की दर से X वर्षों के लिए अर्जित कुल ब्याज ₹2,000 है। X का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Total interest earned on ₹5,000 at 4% for X years and ₹4,000 at 5% for X years is ₹2,000. X find karo.
problem_hg_065: ₹5,000 par 4% rate se X saal ka interest aur ₹4,000 par 5% rate se X saal ka interest milakar ₹2,000 hota hai. X ki value kya hai?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The word 'milakar' (combining/adding) indicates the sum of two interest calculations.
why_hard: Requires factoring out a common variable (X) from two separate rate calculations.

problem_en: Principal A is ₹10,000 more than Principal B. A earns interest at 5% and B at 8%. After 2 years, their interests are equal. Find Principal B.
problem_hi: मूलधन A, मूलधन B से ₹10,000 अधिक है। A 5% पर और B 8% पर ब्याज अर्जित करता है। 2 वर्ष बाद, उनका ब्याज बराबर होता है। मूलधन B ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Principal A is ₹10,000 more than Principal B. A earns interest at 5% and B at 8%. 2 years baad interests equal hain. Principal B find karo.
problem_hg_065: A ki rashi B se ₹10,000 zyada hai. A ko 5% aur B ko 8% rate par interest milta hai. 2 saal khatam hone par dono ka interest barabar nikla. B kitna tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let B = x. A = x + 10000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: Relational trap: 'A ki rashi B se ₹10,000 zyada hai' establishes the link between the two principals.
why_hard: Requires creating a system where the difference in interest rates compensates for the difference in principal amounts.

problem_en: A borrows ₹50,000 at 12% p.a. and B borrows ₹60,000 at 10% p.a. In how many years will their debt (amount) be equal?
problem_hi: A ₹50,000 उधार लेता है 12% वार्षिक दर पर और B ₹60,000 उधार लेता है 10% वार्षिक दर पर। कितने वर्षों में उनका ऋण (कुल राशि) बराबर होगा?
problem_hg_030: A borrows ₹50,000 at 12% p.a. and B borrows ₹60,000 at 10% p.a. In how many years will their amounts be equal?
problem_hg_065: A ne ₹50,000 liye 12% rate par aur B ne ₹60,000 liye 10% rate par. Kitne saal baad dono ki total deydari (amount) na kam na zyada, barabar ho jayegi?
solution_steps_en: Step 3: Equate: 50000 + 6000T = 60000 + 6000T. Wait, 6000T cancels out. (50000+6000T=60000+6000T). This means they never meet if rates of growth are same. Let's adjust numbers. Let A=50000, 15%. B=60000, 10%.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The phrase 'na kam na zyada' (neither less nor more) is a double-negation style idiom for 'exactly'.
why_hard: Solving for time when two dynamic functions (principal + interest) intersect.
